name: ajitta
description: ajitta's Claude Code plugins, side by side. A catalog only: each plugin also serves itself from its own repository, which is the recommended install.

plugins.name: game-engagement-retention
plugins.description: Three routed skills for designing in-session reward moments and lifecycle retention for games and consumer interactive apps — the scene, the cohort, and the link between them.

plugins.name: unknowns
plugins.description: Know your unknowns — an operational loop for finding and managing the gaps between the map (plan) and the territory (reality). 11 skills, 2 agents, 2 hooks across pre-implementation, implementation and post-implementation.

plugins.name: socratic-brainstorm
plugins.description: Modern Socratic questioning (one question at a time) to test an idea, then your own options plus up to three labeled ones, convergence by criteria, and an honest verdict with a short brief.

plugins.name: socratic-elenchus
plugins.description: The method of Plato's early dialogues: what is X, premises you agree to, a contradiction built from them, and your revised definitions as the new ideas. Usually ends in aporia. No advice.
